name: Men Slim Fit Cotton Formal Shirt
review_snippets: Looks sharp but runs small — I had to size up from my usual M to L.
Slim fit is quite snug across the chest. Fabric quality is decent for the price.
Colour matches the photo. Sleeves on M were a bit short on me.

name: Women Printed Straight Cotton Kurta
review_snippets: True to size. I wear M everywhere and M was a perfect fit.
Soft cotton, colours didn't fade after a wash. Length is as described.
Comfortable for office — not clingy, not oversized.

name: Women Mid-Rise Skinny Fit Jeans
review_snippets: Runs small in the waist — I usually wear 28 but needed 30.
True to size for me. Stretch is good, didn't gap at the back.
Nice wash but the thigh is tight. Sizing feels inconsistent across batches.

name: Women Solid A-Line Midi Dress
review_snippets: True to size. Zipper sits well; I didn't need to size up.
Lining is good quality. Waist nips in exactly where it should in M.
Wore it to a work dinner — fabric doesn't crease much in a cab.
